title: decision: spawn_blocking is correct bridge for LMDB and RocksDB sync I/O
description: In post/lmdb_store.rs and post/rocks_store.rs, all blocking I/O is dispatched via tokio::task::spawn_blocking. This is the correct async/sync bridge; LMDB write transactions serialize internally and blocking the thread pool is the right model. Do not replace with async I/O wrappers.
